title: Improved constants in the H2 estimate for the Langevin dynamics: C = 2 and logarithmic dimension scaling of C'
author: Étienne Bernard; Max Fathi; Antoine Levitt; Gabriel Stoltz
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 5 (2022), pp. 523-557, publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.129
difficulty_reason: 912-946以熵对偶和LSI控制Bochner余项，改用最大梯度指数积分把维度因子压成log d，并优化自由常数。它提供一般resolvent界没有的维度改进，保留独立目标；常规Villani/高斯系数/H2控制链保留为支撑。

primary.label: author proposition environment with its own label prop:scaling_dimension_Langevin_improved (source line 899); statement at source lines 899-908, printed as Proposition 3.9 in the journal: for the quadratic kinetic energy, if e^{-beta V} in L^1(D), nu satisfies a logarithmic Sobolev inequality, and the Hessian grows at most linearly as ||nabla^2 V(q)||_{B(l^2)} <= c_3 (1 + |nabla V(q)|_inf) (numbered equation eq:condition_Hessian_LSI), then the conclusion of Proposition prop:estimate_cLa^2_invBBstar holds with C = 2 and the explicit C' = 2(c_3 + (1/(2 c_3 C_LSI))[log d + log max_i integral e^{2 c_3 C_LSI |partial_i V|} d nu])

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement: the Hessian growth assumption replaces the Bochner Cauchy-Schwarz step by the sharper quadratic-variation bound ||nabla_q^2 u||^2 <= ||nabla_q^* nabla_q u||^2 + c_3 ||nabla_q u||^2 + c_3 integral |nabla_q u|^2 |nabla V|_inf d nu (numbered equation), the last term is controlled not by Lemma lem:VillaniA24 but by the classical entropy inequality (justified through the Legendre duality between entropy and log-Laplace), the c-weighted bound on integral |nabla_q u|^2 |nabla V|_inf d nu is split into an LSI-controlled entropy factor and a dimension factor bounded by log d + log of the maximal exponential integral of the partial derivatives of V, taking c = eps^{-1} c_3 C_LSI yields the bound with the explicit constant L'_{d,eps}, and the final assembly delegates to the end of the proof of Proposition prop:estimate_cLa^2_invBBstar with eps = 1/2 (source lines 912-946)
